T: Assemble the team. Then feed them.
D: Batman and Wonder Woman recruit a team of heroes to stop Steppenwolf and the Mother Boxes.
P: Serve the snacks when Barry agrees to join the team in his junk-filled lair.
S: Barry burning through energy at super speed
Small buttermilk pancakes cooked in butter, stacked high with crisp bacon and maple syrup, enough for someone who runs faster than light.
the Icelandic fishing village where Bruce finds Arthur
Rye crispbread spread with crème fraîche, topped with smoked salmon, dill and thin pickled onion, laid out on a slate.

Pretzel rods dipped in melted white chocolate, set on baking paper, then drizzled with blue icing lines like circuits. Melt 250g white chocolate in short bursts in the microwave, stirring each time. Dip 24 pretzel rods two thirds of the way in, let the excess drip off and lay on baking paper. Chill 15 minutes until set. Melt 50g more white chocolate and tint it bright blue with gel colouring. Spoon into a snap-lock bag, snip a tiny corner and pipe thin straight lines and dots like circuits. Sprinkle with a pinch of silver cachous and chill to set.
M: Lake house garlic butter rib eye
the team gathering at Bruce's lake house

Rib eye seared hard and butter basted with garlic, rested 5 minutes, sliced with crispy roast potatoes and charred broccolini. Take 4 rib eye steaks out 30 minutes early and season well. Parboil 1kg potatoes in chunks for 8 minutes, rough them up and roast in oil at 220C for 45 minutes. Sear the steaks in a smoking pan 3 minutes a side, then add 60g butter, 3 crushed garlic cloves and thyme and baste for 1 minute. Rest 5 minutes. Char 2 bunches broccolini in the same pan with a squeeze of lemon. Slice the steak and pour over the pan butter.
Diana and her home island of Themyscira
Lamb leg rubbed with lemon, garlic and oregano, roasted at 180C for 90 minutes, with a tomato, cucumber and feta salad.
W: Vanilla ice cream with a salted caramel sauce of sugar, cream and butter, scattered with popping candy just before serving.
K: Arthur Curry knocking back whisky in the village

Scotch whisky over plenty of ice with fresh lime and a honey ginger syrup, topped with ginger ale and a thick lime wedge. Simmer 3 tbsp honey with 3 tbsp water and 1 tbsp grated ginger for 2 minutes, then cool and strain. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice. Add 45ml Scotch whisky, 1 tbsp of the ginger syrup and the juice of a quarter lime to each. Top with 150ml cold ginger ale and stir once. Garnish with a lime wedge. For non-drinkers, skip the whisky and double the ginger syrup.

s.note: Barry burning through energy at super speed
s.how: Whisk 250g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 2 eggs and 375ml buttermilk to a thick batter. Cook small pancakes in butter until golden. Fry 8 rashers of bacon until crisp. Stack the pancakes high with bacon between them and pour over maple syrup.

s.note: the Icelandic fishing village where Bruce finds Arthur
s.how: Spread rye crispbreads with creme fraiche. Top each with a fold of smoked salmon, a sprig of dill and a few thin rings of pickled onion. Lay them out on a slate and serve cold, like a snack in a fishing village on the edge of the world.

m.note: Diana and her home island of Themyscira
m.how: Rub a 2kg lamb leg with lemon juice, crushed garlic, oregano, olive oil and salt. Roast at 180C for 90 minutes, then rest for 15 minutes. Toss chopped tomatoes, cucumber and crumbled feta with olive oil and lemon and serve with the sliced lamb.

w.how: Melt 150g sugar to an amber caramel, then whisk in 150ml cream and 30g butter with a pinch of salt. Scoop vanilla ice cream into bowls and pour over the warm caramel. Scatter with popping candy just before serving so it crackles.
